name: toss-cli
description: Encode a file to QR PNG frames and decode them back.

scripts.build: npm run build -w toss-core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w toss-core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w toss-core && vitest run
